entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: A baker-like caretaker of her village in Kessig chosen by the Dawnhart Coven to oversee the Harvesttide festivities, who frees her sister from a cursed mask.

entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: Leinore's younger sister, who puts on a strange snake-fanged mask, becomes possessed by Saryth's power, and is later freed.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The leader of the Dawnhart Coven, who promises to fix the imbalance of light and dark through Harvesttide and tries to destroy Sinnia to stop the Coiled One.

entities.name: Jagger
entities.description: The noisiest trapper in Leinore's village, who accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers.

entities.name: Saryth
entities.description: A woman with glowing green eyes whose power is in the mask; she feeds ensorcelled villagers to eggs to call the Coiled One and is swallowed by the chasm.

entities.name: The Coiled One
entities.description: A huge serpent-like being called up by Saryth and fed with villagers, which retreats into the earth when the mask is torn off.

entities.name: Sinnia's mask
entities.description: A scale-crusted deep-gold mask with snake-like sticks and wooden fangs that holds all of Saryth's power and fuses to Sinnia's skin.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: The witches of Kessig who revived Harvesttide to restore the balance between light and darkness.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: An ancient festival of Kessig, now revived by the witches, meant to bring hope and restore the balance between light and darkness.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: A golden glowing structure with metallic rings in the Ulvenwald where the festival camp and the witches' dais are set up.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The rural region of Innistrad where Leinore's village and the festival are.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: The forest in Kessig where all roads lead to the Celestus.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city with buildings bigger than all of Kessig's houses put together.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: A disturbance after which the nights grew longer and the days too short.

entities.name: The Cursemute
entities.description: A spell that had cured many werewolves; when it broke, the werewolves' bloodlust carried them off, including the sisters' mother.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: A name the witches give to the black dirt clinging to their teeth during their invocations.

entities.name: Leinore and Sinnia's mother
entities.description: A werewolf who was carried off to the woods when the Cursemute broke and was said to have been killed by a bear.

events.summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move, while the festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope but more people go missing.
events.quote: Leinore found the dead snake mixed in the ashes of a campfire gone cold hours ago.

events.summary: At an abandoned tent of a missing family, Sinnia finds a scale-crusted golden mask and tries it on over Leinore's objections.
events.quote: Sinnia took off her fox mask and tried on the new one, causing Leinore to flinch.

events.summary: At the Celestus Leinore sees that the witches are binding human teeth into necklaces for the festivalgoers, and Katilda calls them werewolf teeth.
events.quote: "They are teeth," she said plainly. "Werewolf teeth."

events.summary: Jagger accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers and the crowd turns angry.
events.quote: "Did you steal those from the missing villagers?"

events.summary: Sinnia, wearing the mask, calms the crowd with a speech and the villagers shout to bring back the light and gather around her.
That night Sinnia, still masked, tells Leinore that the Coiled One has spoken to her and is surfacing.
events.quote: The Coiled One has spoken to me today, sister.

events.summary: Over the next days Sinnia replaces Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide and makes villagers cough up small snakes while the crowd rejoices.
events.quote: Sinnia had replaced Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide in the eyes of the festivalgoers.

events.summary: Katilda offers Sinnia a coven headpiece in exchange for the mask, and Sinnia laughs in her face.
events.quote: But Sinnia laughed in Katilda's face and turned away.

events.summary: Leinore pretends to sleep and then follows Sinnia into the forest at night.
events.quote: Leinore followed Sinnia into the night.

events.summary: Leinore sees Sinnia drag an unconscious man to a giant egg that opens and swallows him, and notices a woman watching from the shadows.
events.quote: To Leinore's horror, she watched her sister push the unconscious man into it.

events.summary: Katilda grabs Leinore and aims her staff at Sinnia, but Leinore bites her hand and ruins the shot.
events.quote: Without thinking, Leinore bit down on Katilda's hand.

events.summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
events.quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

events.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
events.quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

events.summary: Katilda fights Saryth with shale and a razor wind of leaves, and Saryth falls into the chasm and is swallowed.
events.quote: And in an instant, Saryth was gone—swallowed by the chasm.

events.summary: Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
events.quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

events.summary: With the mask gone the Coiled One bellows and retreats into the earth, pulling the eggs down with it.
events.quote: With one last hiss, the Coiled One dragged its body to the depths of the earth

events.summary: Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement, where freed festivalgoers wander dazed and remember nothing, though many remain missing.
events.quote: Soon, they found people stumbling around, wondering among themselves how they got there and which day of the festival it was.

relations.quote: Her little sister always teased her with kindness.
Katilda, the leader of the coven, promised she could fix the imbalance if the festival was a successful one

relations.note: Saryth fights Katilda in the clearing.
relations.quote: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw Saryth aiming her staff at Katilda now.

relations.note: All of Saryth's power is in the mask.
relations.quote: All of Saryth's power is in that mask.

relations.note: She called it and fed it ensorcelled villagers.
relations.quote: Saryth called him to chase the darkness away and has been feeding him those ensorcelled townsfolk for days now.

relations.note: They work together against Saryth despite their disagreement.
relations.quote: "Let me try. You have to distract Saryth for me."

relations.note: He distrusts and accuses the witches.
relations.quote: "I don't trust someone who tells me nothing," spat Jagger.
